description: This file defines the Meta class, a central component responsible for managing metadata and value descriptors for document objects within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Internals namespace. It provides methods for retrieving, setting, and checking values of document object members, as well as adding value descriptors based on the document object's type information.

classes.name: Meta
classes.description: A sealed class managing metadata and descriptors for document objects, allowing dynamic access and modifications to object members.

methods.name: GetMeta
methods.description: Retrieves the Meta instance associated with a given DocumentObject.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified member from a DocumentObject, supporting nested member access.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified member in a DocumentObject, supporting nested member modification.

methods.name: HasValue
methods.description: Checks whether the metadata contains a descriptor for a specified member name.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Sets the specified member of a DocumentObject to null.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks whether a specific member or the entire DocumentObject is null.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Sets all members of a DocumentObject to null.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Determines whether all members of a DocumentObject are null.

methods.name: AddValueDescriptors
methods.description: Adds value descriptors to the meta from the nested type of the derived class, based on reflection.
